review_description: I contacted Clayton Solar about installation of a solar battery. A quote was provided with explanation of various sizes and which one would be the best for us. The guys who installed the battery were so helpful with battery placement. They were efficient and cleaned up once they finished the work. They installed the app on my phone and explained how the app worked. I could not praise them highly enough. From quote to instillation they were professional and helpful with any questions that i had. Totally recommend Clayton Electrical.

We had a 6.6kw panels-only system installed by Clayton Solar in August 2022, and now in October 2025 had them come out to install our Alpha-ESS 13.3kw battery too. There was no issue installing some extra reinforcing as our roof required. We had the same installer both times, he was knowledgeable and friendly. Went over every detail that was required, installed in locations that suited me and didn't even judge me for my embarassing wifi password...I can't rate Clayton Solar highly enough, they were more competitively priced than others and installed to a high standard. We were given a large amount of information on the systems we were debating and it made me feel confident to pick what we did. Communication was reliable and effective.

Clayton Solar Electrical are a great company to deal with.Price was very competitive (I received at least 15 quotes from other companies), but Clayton were the best. Excellent communication from the first contact to the last.Installers were terrific and did a terrific job and also communicated everything they were doing, and were polite and courteous.Quality work, system is working perfectly and looks terrific.Could not fault them in any way. Would not hesitate in using them again and highly recommend them to others.Steve

Easy to deal with from start to finish. Quality install. System has been working well from day 1 with no issues. We had an old 3 phase inverter removed and replaced with Sig gateway, batteries and inverter. We also had a 2nd inverter from shed integrated through the SmartPort.

Initial quoting was very responsive and competitive. Shane provided me multiple options based on the criteria I provided and was clear on timeframes.The install took about a day and a half for 20kw of panels, 32kwh battery, gateway, car charger - and the crew (especially Tim) were very friendly and professional.I had done a lot of research beforehand and all the guys were clearly knowledgable about the products and took pride in their work, with a very clean install and tidy up.Post install I was given a tour of the functions and also a clear explanation on safety and shut down proceedures.My solar, battery, and blackout protection were up and running on the day of install, and flawlessly integrated into my home assistant system.Very happy with the service provided

Right from the first phone call, Stav and the team couldn't be more helpful. They were always willing to answer any of my questions and provide their expert advice about upgrading my solar inverter and installing a new battery.They kept me informed and updated the whole way, and on the day of the install, they did a very professional and neat job.Stav is so friendly and easy to talk to and explained everything to me. He set up the phone app and explained everything.Great businesses, who are professional, friendly, helpful, and good value for money are hard to find, and I highly recommend Stav, and the guys at Clayton Solar & Electrical

We came back to Clayton solar & electrical after they did our solar install some years ago. We received the same service as last time - absolutely faultless all the way through from quoting to installation and post-sales service. We wouldn’t go anywhere else. Highly  recommend!

A very responsive installer who gave great service throuhhout. Very helpful advice in developing our quote and happy to communicate with me during the installation process. Quote seemed very competitive and the Sigenergy system is performing brilliantly so far. Helped that someone cancelled their order and we were able to get our system installed a couple of months early.

I was very happy with the way the quoting/planning process was handled. Nothing was too much trouble whenever I had any questions for Shane. Prompt replies were always received.Tim and the installation team did a fantastic job replacing our existing solar system together with the provision of our new battery with backup gateway. The result is a very neat and tidy installation. I am very happy with how it all turned out.I would not hesitate to recommend Clayton Solar to anyone looking for a solar/battery installation.

Very responsive to any questions I had and changes to the quote. Despite bad weather, installation was quick and the team were punctual, friendly and polite. They organised grid connection and came back to fix the meter installation (installed by my energy retailer). Showed me through the app and what to expect from my system. Nothing was too hard. It’s been a great experience overall thanks to Shane, Jack, Lachlan, Tim, Stavros and the rest of the team.

The sales process was extremely easy, with Shane being very prompt with quotes and any changes I needed. He explained everything clearly and gave honest opinions on the best value-for-money systems.Installation, as always, was exceptional – Tim and his team were very friendly and accommodating with my requests.After-sales service is also excellent with Clayton Solar – nothing is ever an issue. This is why I continue to return to them

Shane, Stavros and the team are amazing.Quality advice that’s easy to understand and willing to help any time.I’ve now had both a solar systems and a battery with zero issues, great performance and great care for quality and aesthetics.The real surprise is that all this comes and price that literally no one came close to matching.
Great installation job by the team and they picked a great place for the battery, helped with the app installation and use, I got a bigger battery than expected so it was excellent value for money!

I chose Clayton Solar & Electrical to install my system a few years ago; because of their friendly customer service, helpful professional advice in choosing the right product/s, and competitive quote. They went on to impress me further with a seamless installation by a friendly team, and by helping me to navigate the steps required for my energy provider, connecting to Wi-Fi, using the app, and much more. Since then, Shane has provided ongoing technical support & advice anytime I’ve needed it over the years, including prompt advice on how to safely isolate the system after recently suffering major storm damage.So when this storm damage meant I needed a replacement system, I was understandably concerned that the building company managing my repairs was intending to assign their own solar installer to do so. I didn’t want to lose my preferred solar support team! After explaining this to the building supervisor, he agreed to onboard Clayton Solar to do my new installation, for which I am incredibly grateful.My second installation by Clayton Solar went as smoothly as the first, including the post install support again. I love that most of the team was the same as the first time, a sign that it must be a great place to work too, and Tim even went above and beyond by cleaning storm debris out of my garage for me before heading off (it was still full of leaves and dirt from the storm).Reading positive reviews lead me to Clayton Solar in the first place, so I hope this one helps you to choose too. I can’t recommend them highly enough, and of note I have since received thanks from my repairs building company for the referral… it seems they are so impressed by the team that they are already seeking their services again.Thank you Shane, Tim & all of the team at Clayton Solar.

We recently had a 13.4kWh Sigenergy battery and solar panels installed by Clayton Solar and couldn't be happier with the experience.The team was professional, punctual, and transparent throughout the process- from quoting G to post installation support.They took the time to explain setup, system performance, and monitoring app in plain language.The installation was tidy, and the system is working exactly as promised.Highly recommend Clayton Solar for anyone  looking for a reliable, knowledgeable solar provider.

I’m very happy with my solar power system from Clayton Solar and Electrical. It was an easy process from start to finish. Competitive price, friendly and professional team.
Process was easy. Tim and the team were all very friendly

As they still had the same senior staff were always going to be in contention  for this job.It is hard to rate whether it was value for money as Sigenergy is a new product which has not had a chance to prove its worth yet despite the expensive price tag yet, so I am guessing a bit and could only rate 4 out of 5 for that reason.The job was started on time exactly when first scheduled and as expected they didn't let me down. All the guys on site were quality people, friendly, well mannered and very easy to speak to.The workmanship was of the highest quality again, the office staff organised all of the paperwork and set things up for the grid connection, the whole process went very smoothly and I am extremely happy and highly recommend Clayton Solar. You will definitely not be disappointed!!!
Shane, Stavros & team were very professional, conducted prompt installation and provided us with detailed information on the battery, install and app. Highly recommend

Sales/Quoting process was prompt - Shane was quick to reply to my email queries & we arranged a house visit to discuss/work out the best system for our current & future needsThe installation for panels & battery was over 2 days, the team of 4 completed the work in a timely manner.Clayton Solar arranged the grid connection & showed us our to monitor the appWe were very impressed with the company - the onboarding approach was not pushy - just gave us good advice & recommendationsWe would recommend Clayton Solar

Great customer service from the beginning, installation booked & completed promptly and both sales and electrical staff exhibited fantastic knowledge and support with component selections.  Would highly recommend!
